Chapter 1215 - 27: Those Who Block The Galaxy, Body And Soul Shattered (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 1215: Chapter 27: Those Who Block the Galaxy, Body and Soul Shattered (Subscription Requested)_2

In the eyes of the Peak Venerable of the Da Fu Ancient Country, the fact that the Galaxy Venerate dared to appear here certainly means he has confidence and backup, most likely from other Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

To deal with the Galaxy Venerate, Fu Yun Venerate is enough. The attention of Fu Yu Venerate and the other Peak Venerables should be on the other Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country lurking around.

"Is it Chi Yan and the others who have used the ultimate weapon?"

Fu Yu Venerate wondered to himself, becoming more cautious.

Under normal circumstances, the ultimate weapon of a great Ancient Country would surely be kept for last.

Firstly, the real killer move should be used at a critical moment.

Secondly, the ultimate weapon is incredibly precious, and using it means having less of it.

The ultimate weapon is reserved for the end, used based on the final situation.

If there is hope to seize the treasured land, naturally the ultimate weapon can be used.

If there is no hope to seize the treasured land, naturally there is no need to continue the investment and effort.

But who knows what the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is thinking? In case they plan to use the ultimate weapon now, Fu Yu Venerate must consider this extreme scenario.

"Galaxy Venerate, I’ve long wanted to see you..."

Fu Yun Venerate manipulated a large mass of clouds, intending to crush towards Lin Yuan.

This move is a killer move specifically for strong opponents of the same level, first suppressing with clouds, then eroding.

However—

"Huh?"

Fu Yun Venerate suddenly found his vision empty, only a terrifying convergence and collision of the black and white Yin-Yang colors engulfing him, their ominous aura making him feel despair.

"No!"

Fu Yun Venerate did not have time to react before his physical body, soul, mind, and will swiftly collapsed and perished.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan raised his hand and collected the weapon Fu Yun Venerate left behind.

Silence.

The fall of Fu Yun Venerate plunged all the Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country into complete silence.

Even though the fallen body of Fu Yun Venerate was just a main battle body and not his complete death, it still sent chills down the spines of the other Peak Venerables.

After collecting Fu Yun Venerate’s weapon, Lin Yuan glanced at the last position where he stood: "Facing me, you still dare to be distracted?"

Exactly, Lin Yuan could clearly feel that even though Fu Yun Venerate attacked him, he still had a small part of his attention focused on the surroundings.

Not only did Fu Yu Venerate believe the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s Peak Venerables were ambushing nearby, but Fu Yun Venerate also thought so, which naturally meant he wasn’t fully focused on Lin Yuan.

Of course.

Even though Fu Yun Venerate was distracted, he was still a top Peak Venerable. However, being instantly killed by Lin Yuan was still somewhat unbelievable.

"Is my Chaotic Taiji Dao so powerful, even at just the first level?"

Lin Yuan pondered to himself. Facing the numerous Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country, naturally, he did not dare hold back, directly using the Chaos Taiji Power.

"This power?"

Fu Yu Venerate’s heart trembled. The path of chaos power he evolved was very special and could slightly ’see’ the cause of Fu Yun Venerate’s death, a continually intertwining, colliding force of black and white, Yin and Yang, ultimately shattering everything of Fu Yun Venerate.

"Do not get distracted, attack the Galaxy Venerate with all your might."

Fu Yu Venerate immediately commanded the other Peak Venerables. At this moment, he vaguely realized that the Galaxy Venerate dared to appear here, perhaps not due to external support, but his own strength?

"Fu Yun, a top Peak Venerable, instantly fell to the Galaxy Venerate? How strong is this Galaxy Venerate?" The Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country felt uneasy, but none of them thought of fleeing.

The giant core heavenly pillar was right behind them; who dared to flee?

And the fact that the Galaxy Venerate could kill Fu Yun Venerate doesn’t mean he could do the same to them, especially since the numerous Peak Venerables were already highly prepared for this.

"How has this Galaxy Venerate’s strength increased so much?" Among the Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country, Fu Dang Venerate also stared intently at Lin Yuan, looking shocked.

Upon first entering the treasured land, Fu Dang Venerate once tried to seize the core heavenly pillar discovered by Red Lotus Venerable. Then Lin Yuan arrived and completely took down one of his main battle bodies.

At that time, Lin Yuan’s oppression on Fu Dang Venerate was significant but not as insurmountable as now?

"Form the battle formation!"

Just as Fu Yu Venerate’s words fell, the remaining ten Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country connected faintly, wisps of Chaos Qi swirling, incorporating the power of all the Peak Venerables into a grand cycle.

"Hmm?"

"The application of Chaos Rule?"

Lin Yuan scrutinized the scene.

Back in the battlefield between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain, Lin Yuan had discovered that the war machines of various Ancient Countries could completely fuse the power of thousands or even tens of thousands of different strong warriors into one.

The fundamental reason was that the Chaos Rule governed all forces.

And at this moment, the power of ten Peak Venerables, including five top Peak Venerables, was completely integrated into a grand cycle, surging forward and crushing everything.

This was done by leveraging the Chaos Rule, even surpassing the essence of the Chaos Third Realm.

After all, wanting to fully integrate the power of ten Peak Venerables was not something easily accomplished.

"Galaxy Venerate, take this strike of mine."

Fu Dang Venerate felt an unprecedented strength, as his aura merged with the other four Peak Venerables, becoming even stronger than ordinary top Peak Venerables. Together with the other four top Peak Venerables, forming a cycle, he felt that nothing in the world could block him.

"Only strength." Lin Yuan silently observed Fu Dang Venerate.

At the same time, he raised his hand and pointed a finger, strands of black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power extending from his fingertip towards Fu Dang Venerate.

Boom!

An invisible space-time barrier suddenly formed on Fu Dang Venerate’s body surface, a protection from the other nine Venerables’ power, yet Lin Yuan’s finger tore through everything, the universe turning into two colors, black and white, filled with Yin-Yang Taiji.

In an instant, the black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power pierced through the space-time barrier, obliterating Fu Dang Venerate’s body and soul instantly.

Not only that, the remaining black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power continued to extend towards the other nine Peak Venerables along the invisible connections.

"Not good."

Fu Yu Venerate’s expression changed drastically, immediately severing the connection with the other Peak Venerables.

The four top Peak Venerables also severed the connection promptly, but the remaining four Peak Venerables reacted a bit slower, touched by the black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power, causing their bodies and souls to start collapsing and disappearing.

In a short time.

In just a few breaths.

Originally eleven Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country fell, six of them, leaving only five.

"Galaxy Venerate, what exactly is your strength now?" Fu Yu Venerate felt a chill, staring straight at Lin Yuan, seemingly with some speculation, yet unwilling to voice it.

"Those who block me shall die."

Lin Yuan didn’t bother to speak further, striding towards the massive core celestial pillar.

Fu Yu Venerate and other top Peak Venerables exchanged looks, their auras once again merging together.

"Stop him."

Fu Yu Venerate gritted his teeth, his inner aura beginning to boil, clearly using various desperate combat techniques.

The other four top Peak Venerables did the same, for the massive core celestial pillar behind them was claimed and refined by the Da Fu Ancient Country, crucial not just for being a pillar, but also representing dignity and respect.

If outsiders still occupied and plundered it under the guard of their numerous Peak Venerables, it would be a massive blow to the exceptionally proud Da Fu Venerables.

Boom boom boom!

Five top Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country launched an all-out attack on Lin Yuan.

At this moment, the five top Peak Venerables appeared frenzied, using all sorts of desperate measures, causing the heavenly path to retreat quickly, vanishing, while the surrounding space-time turned into a black hole, with rules not existing.

Lin Yuan frowned slightly, halting his steps; under the desperate measures of the top Peak Venerables, he couldn’t completely ignore them, especially when these five top Peak Venerables used terrifying methods stemming from the ancient Da Fu Ancient Country.

After a breath.

One top Peak Venerable was shattered by Lin Yuan with a slap.

Half a breath later.

Another top Peak Venerable was crushed under Lin Yuan’s foot.

In just three to four breaths.

All five top Peak Venerables were annihilated one by one by Lin Yuan.

And at this moment, Lin Yuan had just arrived in front of the massive core celestial pillar.

Before this—

Those who block the Galaxy shall lose both body and soul.
